---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new dataset, formula, layer or UI improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem or use case

What gap does this fill? Who benefits, and how?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you have in mind. Sketch screenshots, links to references or
APIs welcome.

## Data sources or references

If this involves new data or a different formula, link the upstream source
(DOI, dataset license, API docs). Conservative bias toward open licenses
that allow redistribution from a static site.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why this is preferred.
